dslRule:
<!id: remove-redundant-auto-refresh-check>
<!description: Remove redundant check for PREF_AUTO_REFRESH in logical OR with PREF_LIGHTWEIGHT_AUTO_REFRESH, as PREF_AUTO_REFRESH is no longer relevant in this context. This is a behavioral change from bug 248068.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$pref.getBoolean(org.eclipse.core.resources.ResourcesPlugin.PREF_AUTO_REFRESH, false) || $pref.getBoolean(org.eclipse.core.resources.ResourcesPlugin.PREF_LIGHTWEIGHT_AUTO_REFRESH, false) :: instanceof($pref, "org.eclipse.core.runtime.preferences.IEclipsePreferences")
=>
$pref.getBoolean(org.eclipse.core.resources.ResourcesPlugin.PREF_LIGHTWEIGHT_AUTO_REFRESH, false)
;;
summary: Replaces a boolean OR condition involving two specific preference checks with only the PREF_LIGHTWEIGHT_AUTO_REFRESH check, reflecting a fix where PREF_AUTO_REFRESH became irrelevant in this context.
